issues.display_title: Issue #1823: [Investigation] Audit Stripe Subscriptions with collection_method: send_invoice
issues.main_description_html:
Goal: Audit Stripe subscriptions configured with collection_method = 'send_invoice', detect potential revenue leakage caused by active services without successful payments, and formulate remediation steps.

Audit Status: Completed (2026-09-07)

  • Detailed User Data: Extracted all live subscriptions; filtered down to 8 live non-canceled subscriptions (2 active, 6 past_due) across 7 distinct users (all 19 canceled subscriptions excluded).
  • Plan Mappings: Aligned with official gothru-dashboard constants (subscriptionCodes.js & pricingPlans.js).
  • Card Verification: Verified saved payment methods directly on live Stripe Customers for all non-free accounts.
  • Remediation Plan: Established actionable operational steps for each user.
  • Deliverables Committed:
    • Audit Report: docs/investigations/2026-09-07-stripe-send-invoice-audit.md
    • Raw JSON Dataset: docs/investigations/2026-09-07-stripe-send-invoice-audit.json

Executive Summary & Key Results

Metric Result
Total Non-Canceled Subscriptions 8 subscriptions (2 active, 6 past_due) across 7 users
Direct Revenue Leakage (Active Paid Tier Unpaid) 3 users (User 51405, User 858, User 1001)
Zombie Invoicing (Free accounts continuously billed) 3 users / 4 subscriptions (Users 830, 48503, 30385)
Total Open (Unpaid) Invoices 287 open invoices
Total Uncollected Balance $3,500.45 USD + €1,943.45 EUR (~$5,650+ USD equivalent)
Origin Note Legacy system debt — current API has zero code/config creating send_invoice subscriptions.

Core Findings & Revenue Leakage

  1. Active Services Rendered Without Payment (Direct Leakage):
    • User 51405: Enjoys Basic Monthly tier (subscribtion = 2) with 6 overdue monthly invoices ($60.00 unpaid).
    • User 858: Enjoys Basic Monthly tier (subscribtion = 2) with 21 overdue monthly invoices (€243.00 unpaid).
    • User 1001: Enjoys Pro Monthly tier (subscribtion = 1) with 2 unpaid invoices ($30.00).
  2. Zombie Auto-Invoicing on Free Accounts:
    • Users 830, 48503, and 30385 are on Free tier (subscribtion = 0), but Stripe keeps generating monthly invoices indefinitely because send_invoice subscriptions never auto-cancel upon non-payment.
    • User 830 accumulated 142 open invoices across two duplicate subscriptions created in Oct 2020 (~€3,400+).
  3. Database Misattribution:
    • User 51405's two paid invoices (ch_3SpZMj..., ch_3TMDBy...) were mistakenly recorded under user_id = 774 in cc_purchase.

Operational Remediation Plan

1. Auto-Charge Migration Strategy (Based on Live Saved Cards)

  • User 51405: Has valid card (MasterCard ...6868, Exp 12/2034). Switch subscription to charge_automatically and execute payment on the 6 overdue invoices ($60). If successful, retain service; if rejected, downgrade to Free.
  • User 1001: Has valid card (MasterCard ...8207, Exp 02/2028). Switch subscription to charge_automatically to automate future renewals.
  • User 21655: Has valid card (Visa ...3217, Exp 12/2026). Switch subscription to charge_automatically for June 2027 renewal.
  • User 858 (Special Case): NO SAVED CARD on Stripe. Cannot be auto-charged. Immediately set users.subscribtion = 0 (downgrade to Free) and cancel subscription sub_K60sgiGcl3ZtJh on Stripe. Notify user to enter a valid card to resubscribe.

2. Zombie Subscription & Open Invoice Cleanup

  • Cancel the 4 remaining zombie subscriptions on Free accounts (sub_I9azO3tP3mEntL, sub_I9HT1RKVWtYrIV, sub_IcxoKNXk6ZqQYz, sub_1LlEQP4UXotNjjkIlR76POOF) to halt recurring invoice creation.
  • Bulk-void or mark uncollectible the 287 open invoices on Stripe to clean accounting books.
  • Re-attribute cc_purchase IDs 152557 and 158419 to User 51405.

issues.display_title: Issue #1824: [Audit] Stripe Price IDs Missing from DB & Pricing Discrepancies (Legacy/Regional Plans)
issues.main_description_html:
📌 Background

Several subscriptions in Stripe use legacy/regional price_ids that:

  1. Are not registered in the ccdb.product catalog (and lack metadata.product_id) → renewals are skipped by cron (skipped_no_product) and unrecorded in cc_purchase.
  2. Pricing Discrepancies: Users pay amounts that do not match standard catalog pricing (e.g., paying $15/mo while holding a Pro tier entitlement normally priced at $34/mo).

🎯 Objective

Audit all Stripe price_ids not present in the DB ccdb.product catalog, map affected users along with pricing anomalies (amount paid vs. tier entitlement), and provide remediation recommendations.

📋 Audit Status: COMPLETED

  • Extract all price_ids from active and past_due Stripe subscriptions (907 subscriptions scanned: 860 active, 47 past_due).
  • Filter price_ids missing from ccdb.product.plan_stripe / plan_stripe_test (12 distinct price IDs found).
  • Pricing Discrepancy Audit: Compare actual billed amount vs. official tier price (users.subscribtion).
  • Consolidate dataset: price_id, billed amount/currency, user tier, email/user_id, Stripe status.
  • Provide remediation recommendations (Stripe metadata backfill vs DB catalog expansion).
  • Output report & dataset to docs/investigations/ (Report Markdown, Raw JSON Dataset).

📊 Audit Results Summary

  • Total Stripe Prices in Live Use: 23 Price IDs
    • Registered in ccdb.product: 11 Price IDs (892 items / 99.0% of total subscriptions)
    • Unregistered in ccdb.product: 12 Price IDs (16 items across 14 distinct users)
  • Stripe Metadata Deficiency: 100% (12 out of 12) unregistered price IDs have empty metadata.product_id = null.
  • Unrecorded Revenue: Over 260+ paid renewal transactions (~$17,500+ USD/EUR) were skipped by cron (resolveProductId() => null) and are missing from ccdb.cc_purchase.

🚨 Critical Desynchronization Case: User 39284

  • User ID 39284 (GoThru@VR360.space): Paying $15/month for 39 consecutive months ($585.00 USD) on active Stripe subscription sub_1NIC524UXotNjjkIq7U0KWNn.
  • Database State: users.subscribtion = 0 (Free), recurring_profile = null, and 0 records in cc_purchase.
  • Action Needed: Set users.subscribtion = 2 (Basic Monthly), attach recurring_profile, and backfill 39 transactions to cc_purchase.

🔗 Cross-Reference: Dual Anomalies with Issue #1823 (send_invoice)

6 out of 14 users in this audit (21655, 51405, 858, 830, 30385, 48503) also appear in #1823 with collection_method = 'send_invoice', causing uncollected open invoices alongside missing catalog pricing.

🛠️ Proposed Remediation

  1. Stripe Metadata Backfill (Zero Code Change): Add metadata.product_id to the 12 Stripe price objects so the recurring cron recognizes them immediately.
  2. Fix User 39284 Entitlement & Backfill Ledger: Update status to Basic Monthly and backfill 39 missing purchases.
  3. Zombie Subscriptions Cleanup: Cancel Stripe subscriptions and void open invoices for free accounts (Users 830, 30385, 48503, 858).
